description: The GPT/ChatGPT detection layer: the assistant-register tells and vocabulary cluster detectors associate with OpenAI models. Documented from detector research (GPTZero, Turnitin, Winston AI), university detection guides, and community pattern lists.

fingerprint.name: Assistant identity leak
fingerprint.pattern: Lines that reveal the model's assistant training register
fingerprint.example: As an AI language model, I cannot provide personal opinions. I'm here to help with any questions you may have.
fingerprint.tell: 'As an AI language model' is the most famous ChatGPT tell in history. Newer models are trained out of the literal phrase, but the register survives in variants: 'As an AI,', 'I'm here to help,', 'I don't have personal opinions.'
fingerprint.fix: Delete the identity line entirely. If an opinion is needed, the writer supplies it.

fingerprint.name: Assistantese closers
fingerprint.example: I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any questions. Feel free to reach out if you need further assistance.
fingerprint.tell: The customer-support register leaks into every genre: essays, reports, and blog posts end with service scripts.
fingerprint.fix: Cut the closer. End on the substance.

fingerprint.name: Deferential opener
fingerprint.example: Certainly! Absolutely. Of course, I'd be happy to help.
fingerprint.tell: GPT opens with a compliance phrase before the actual answer, a reward-model artifact of chat training.

fingerprint.name: Apologetic preamble
fingerprint.pattern: I apologize / I understand your concern before the real response
fingerprint.example: I apologize for the confusion. I understand this can be frustrating. Let me clarify.
fingerprint.tell: GPT pre-empts with apology even when nothing went wrong. The sympathy script is a tell.
fingerprint.fix: Give the correction or the clarification directly. Apologize only when a mistake was made.

fingerprint.name: Listicle default
fingerprint.pattern: Numbered steps or bullet lists for content that is not sequential
fingerprint.example: Here are 5 tips to improve your writing: 1. Read more. 2. Write daily. 3. ...
fingerprint.tell: GPT restructures any request into a numbered list. Listicle framing ('Here are X tips', 'Here are some ways') is its default answer shape.
fingerprint.fix: Write prose unless the enumeration is genuinely sequential.

fingerprint.name: Coverage phrasing
fingerprint.pattern: Spraying both sides of every dichotomy
fingerprint.example: Whether you're a beginner or an expert, whether you're a startup or an enterprise, this applies to you.
fingerprint.tell: GPT covers every audience in one sentence because it does not know who is reading.
fingerprint.fix: Pick the reader. Name one audience.

fingerprint.name: The 'intersection' frame
fingerprint.pattern: Naming the topic as an intersection of abstractions
fingerprint.example: The intersection of technology and humanity. The crossroads of marketing and psychology.
fingerprint.tell: GPT frames topics as abstract intersections to sound analytical.

fingerprint.name: GPT vocabulary cluster
fingerprint.example: delve, seamless, unlock, elevate, comprehensive, tailored, navigate, landscape, transform, revolutionize, tap into, empowers, it's important to note, in today's fast-paced world, remember that, keep in mind
fingerprint.tell: GPT's preferred vocabulary overlaps Claude's at the top (delve, pivotal, landscape) but skews more promotional: unlock, elevate, seamless, tailored, comprehensive. Detectors weight the cluster, not single instances.
fingerprint.fix: Replace with concrete terms. 'Unlock the power of X' becomes 'X does Y'. 'Seamless' becomes what actually works.

fingerprint.name: Formulaic emphasis
fingerprint.pattern: Imperative reminders addressed to the reader
fingerprint.example: Remember that consistency is key. Keep in mind that results take time. It's essential to track your progress.
fingerprint.tell: GPT addresses the reader with imperative reminders it learned from self-improvement content.
fingerprint.fix: State the fact without commanding the reader.

fingerprint.name: Clean-slate summary
fingerprint.pattern: Restating the question before answering it
fingerprint.example: To summarize, you asked about X. The answer involves Y and Z.
fingerprint.tell: GPT restates the prompt to buy generation time and appear thorough.
fingerprint.fix: Answer. Do not restate the question.

fingerprint.name: Bold-and-emoji formatting
fingerprint.pattern: Bold lead-ins plus emoji in chat and social output
fingerprint.example:
**Key benefits:**
- Fast setup ✅
- Easy to use ✅
- Scales with you ✅
fingerprint.tell: GPT formats chat replies like marketing pages: bold labels, emoji bullets, checkmark rows.
fingerprint.fix: Plain text. Emoji only for real status meaning.

fingerprint.name: Possibility hedge stack
fingerprint.pattern: Multiple epistemic hedges in one sentence
fingerprint.example: This may potentially help you possibly improve your results.
fingerprint.tell: GPT hedges because it cannot verify the claim. Stacked hedges (may, might, could, potentially, possibly) are its signature.
fingerprint.fix: Cut every hedge. State the claim or drop it.

notes: The GPT fingerprint is the chat-assistant register: compliance openers, service closers, and promotional vocabulary. It overlaps the general slop library at the vocabulary layer and diverges in the assistantese patterns. As with Claude, the fingerprint is statistical: the cluster is the signal, not single instances.
